build_yolox_tta_config: build a YOLOX test-time augmentation config using DetTTAModel with NMS and multi-scale transforms
create_tta_pipeline: create a test-time augmentation pipeline with multi-scale resize, random flip, pad, and pack detection inputs
configure_tta_model: configure the DetTTAModel with NMS iou threshold 0.65 and max 100 detections per image
setup_multi_scale_augmentation: setup multi-scale image augmentation with scales 320x320, 640x640, and 960x960 for YOLOX inference
define_tta_transforms: define test-time augmentation transforms including resize, random flip, pad, and annotation loading for object detection
